Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the 
check list I1 of all valve types, which must be performed every two months as indicated by M2 in the title block.
The first draft initiated and 
tested by 
eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 20 Dec 2003, accepted by General Director eng. Saad Mostafa, 
revised by EDEPCo. eng.. Samir Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of TALKHA power station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
surrounding the work area.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
Isolate valve mechanically and 
electrically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected to 
this valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried Out
Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts or renew the gland packing.
Check any leakage from the pressure tight 
 cover. If it found retighten the cover nut.
Check any internal leakage. If there is any 
 internal leakage it must be carried out the maintenance procedure of this type 
 to prevent the leakage.
Check any leakage from the valve bodies 
 (cracks or mechanical wear). Remark the point of leakage, and welded it with 
 suitable electrode.
Check the operation of the valve drive during 
 closing/ opening of the valve.
Check the electrical drive of the valve for 
 electrical type.
Check the oil level of the gear- motor for 
 electrical drive.
Re-grease the valve spindle.
